title: Work Done by a Rotational Vector Field around a Circle
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Compute the work done by F = <y, -x> along the counterclockwise unit circle r(t) = <cos(t), sin(t)> for 0 <= t <= 2*pi.

steps.title: Compute Differential Vector dr
steps.mathExpression: \mathbf{r}'(t) = \langle -\sin t, \cos t \rangle \implies d\mathbf{r} = \langle -\sin t, \cos t \rangle \, dt

steps.title: Evaluate Vector Field along Path
steps.explanation: Substitute path coordinates into field components.

steps.title: Compute Dot Product and Integrate
steps.mathExpression: \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r} = [(\sin t)(-\sin t) + (-\cos t)(\cos t)] \, dt = -(\sin^2 t + \cos^2 t) \, dt = -1 \, dt; \quad W = \int_0^{2\pi} (-1) \, dt = -2\pi
